run_normalize_punctuation: run the Moses punctuation normalizer on stdin text with language and Penn Treebank options
run_normalize_with_penn: run the normalizer with Penn Treebank punctuation style enabled for English text
run_normalize_custom_lang: run the normalizer on stdin text specifying a custom language code
review_main_normalizer: review the main function that creates a MosesPunctNormalizer and normalizes each stdin line
summarize_moses_normalizer: summarize how the MosesPunctNormalizer from sacremoses normalizes punctuation for a given language
